name: Effect
works_with: TypeScript on Node.js, Bun, Deno and the browser
short: A TypeScript library for production apps, with typed errors, dependency injection, concurrency, tracing and schema validation.
what: Effect is a TypeScript library for the hard parts of large applications: typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing and schema validation. The monorepo also ships packages for SQL databases, AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter and others), React, Solid and Vue bindings, OpenTelemetry and Vitest. Version 4.x is a long-term support release with at least three years of bug and security fixes.
who: TypeScript developers and teams building services they expect to run for years. If you're on Effect 3.x, read the migration guide in the repo first.
needs: TypeScript 5.9 or newer. TypeScript 7 is recommended
Node.js 18 or newer when running on Node. Some packages need more; @effect/sql-sqlite-node needs Node.js 22.16 or newer
The strict flag turned on in tsconfig.json

steps.title: Turn on strict type-checking
steps.text: Effect requires the `strict` flag in your `tsconfig.json`.

steps.title: Add integration packages as you need them
steps.text: For example `@effect/platform-node`, `@effect/sql-pg` or `@effect/ai-anthropic`. All packages are released together with matching versions.

steps.title: Upgrading from 3.x
steps.text: Follow MIGRATION.md in the repo. The v3 code lives on the `v3` branch.
